collection.title: Mercedes-Benz B Class 2011 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz B Class 2011 to 2015 (W246) model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this B Class, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
